import pandas as pd
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
import seaborn as sns

# Load the data
df = pd.read_csv('data/coffee_sales.csv')

# Convert date to datetime for analysis
df['date'] = pd.to_datetime(df['date'])

# Create a figure with multiple subplots for comprehensive visualization
fig, axes = plt.subplots(2, 2, figsize=(14, 12))
fig.suptitle('Coffee Shop Sales Analysis Dashboard', fontsize=16, fontweight='bold', y=1.02)

# 1. Top-left: Sales by Product Type
ax1 = axes[0, 0]
product_sales = df.groupby('product')['total'].sum().sort_values(ascending=True)
colors = sns.color_palette('viridis', len(product_sales))
bars1 = ax1.barh(product_sales.index, product_sales.values, color=colors)
ax1.set_xlabel('Total Sales ($)', fontsize=11)
ax1.set_ylabel('Product', fontsize=11)
ax1.set_title('Total Sales by Product', fontsize=12, fontweight='bold')
for bar, val in zip(bars1, product_sales.values):
    ax1.text(val + 50, bar.get_y() + bar.get_height()/2, f'${val:,.0f}', 
             va='center', fontsize=9)

# 2. Top-right: Sales by Customer Age Group and Size
ax2 = axes[0, 1]
age_size_sales = df.groupby(['customer_age_group', 'size'])['total'].sum().unstack(fill_value=0)
# Reorder age groups logically
age_order = ['18-24', '25-34', '35-44', '45-54', '55+']
age_size_sales = age_size_sales.reindex([a for a in age_order if a in age_size_sales.index])
age_size_sales.plot(kind='bar', ax=ax2, color=sns.color_palette('Set2', 3), width=0.7)
ax2.set_xlabel('Customer Age Group', fontsize=11)
ax2.set_ylabel('Total Sales ($)', fontsize=11)
ax2.set_title('Sales by Age Group and Size', fontsize=12, fontweight='bold')
ax2.legend(title='Size', loc='upper right')
ax2.tick_params(axis='x', rotation=45)

# 3. Bottom-left: Payment Method Distribution (Pie Chart)
ax3 = axes[1, 0]
payment_counts = df['payment_method'].value_counts()
colors_pie = sns.color_palette('pastel', len(payment_counts))
wedges, texts, autotexts = ax3.pie(payment_counts.values, labels=payment_counts.index, 
                                    autopct='%1.1f%%', colors=colors_pie,
                                    explode=[0.02]*len(payment_counts), startangle=90)
ax3.set_title('Payment Method Distribution', fontsize=12, fontweight='bold')
for autotext in autotexts:
    autotext.set_fontsize(10)
    autotext.set_fontweight('bold')

# 4. Bottom-right: Takeaway vs Dine-in Sales by Product
ax4 = axes[1, 1]
takeaway_sales = df.groupby(['product', 'is_takeaway'])['total'].sum().unstack(fill_value=0)
takeaway_sales.columns = ['Dine-in', 'Takeaway']
takeaway_sales.plot(kind='bar', ax=ax4, color=['#66b3ff', '#ff9999'], width=0.7)
ax4.set_xlabel('Product', fontsize=11)
ax4.set_ylabel('Total Sales ($)', fontsize=11)
ax4.set_title('Takeaway vs Dine-in Sales by Product', fontsize=12, fontweight='bold')
ax4.legend(title='Order Type', loc='upper right')
ax4.tick_params(axis='x', rotation=45)

# Add summary statistics as text
total_revenue = df['total'].sum()
avg_transaction = df['total'].mean()
total_transactions = len(df)

fig.text(0.5, -0.02, f'Total Revenue: ${total_revenue:,.2f} | Average Transaction: ${avg_transaction:.2f} | Total Transactions: {total_transactions:,}', 
         ha='center', fontsize=11, style='italic', 
         bbox=dict(boxstyle='round', facecolor='wheat', alpha=0.5))

plt.tight_layout()
plt.savefig('output.png', bbox_inches='tight', dpi=150)
